attributes.parameters_json: {"coarseStepM": 0.25, "corridorEnds": "cut at the angle bisector of the two Creek Segments sharing each vertex, so neighbouring corridors meet on one line", "fileLayout": "one compact JSON file per TNC flowline: water-surface-polygon-sets/<tncComid>.json", "fineStepM": 0.05, "floodFillSeeds": "centerline cells plus every Stage 1 thalweg point inside the Creek Segment corridor", "headroomAboveMaxModeledWseM": 2, "polygonGeneration": "publish water-surface-polygon-generation.ts: corridor width, 8-connectivity, Bank-overlap margin", "wetThreshold": "sloped from the mean downstream junction WSE to the mean upstream junction WSE of the Stage 3 values in the bucket, measured between the corridor boundary lines (0 on the start boundary, 1 on the end boundary), never below the bucket minimum; flat at the bucket minimum when no value fell in it"}
attributes.derivation_summary: Per elevation bucket, flood-fills USGS 3DEP terrain below a wet threshold that slopes from the mean downstream to the mean upstream junction WSE of the modeled values in that bucket, inside a corridor cut at the junction bisectors. The browser draws each polygon sloped between the junction WSEs at the selected time. Built from modeled-wse m1-v1.
